verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents custom note templates or saved prompts that shape AI notes per meeting type. The closest items are developer building blocks: API endpoints that write a note's agenda in Fellow Markdown, and a suggestion to pass transcripts to an external LLM for tailored recaps. These earn no credit, and the product page describes one standard summary format applied to every meeting.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can shape the notes with custom templates or saved prompts per meeting type (discovery call, 1:1, standup) instead of one generic format
